683:t_042:0.en:
$$シベラ$$
「We've received a message from Captain $$マクシミリアン$$ of $$バトル７$$!」

683:t_042:1.en:
$$マックス$$
「Good news! The $$人類銀河同盟$$ has joined the battle too!」

683:t_042:3.en:
$$マックス$$
「With their help, we're bringing the battle back to even odds, or better.」

683:t_042:4.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「A vast swarm of $$バジュラ$$ is supporting us too. You needn't worry about this front.」

683:t_042:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$バジュラ$$... You understood us.」

683:t_042:7.en:
$$マックス$$
「We've also confirmed that the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are engaging the $$宇宙怪獣$$ independently.」

683:t_042:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My records contain no instances of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ conducting joint operations with humanity.」

683:t_042:9.en:
$$レド$$
「That just means those records are out of date now.」

683:t_042:10.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The various $$螺旋族$$s in this universe, once held back by the $$アンチスパイラル$$, are joining the battle one after another.」

683:t_042:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They aren't the only ones fighting.」

683:t_042:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! You're alive?!」

683:t_042:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... Embarrassing as it is, yes.」

683:t_042:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But I don't intend to waste the life I've been given back!」

683:t_042:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We reorganized the scattered $$サイデリアル$$ forces, and they're joining the battle against $$バアル$$ on every front.」

683:t_042:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now that we know Lady $$エルーナ$$'s true intentions, we no longer need to defer to those who ruled $$サイデリアル$$.」

683:t_042:20.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We will fight to live too.」

683:t_042:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's how it is, yes.」

683:t_042:22.en:
$$メール$$
「Honestly! You're such a smooth talker!」

683:t_042:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine by me! First, we have to survive, or nothing else matters!」

683:t_042:24.en:
$$アサキム$$
「They share their hearts and live together...」

683:t_042:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the condition for $$シンカ$$... the truth.」

683:t_042:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Are you watching, $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$?! People can share their hearts without doing things your way!)

683:t_042:27.en:
$$キリコ$$
(That's how it is, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Though you, who sought to advance only yourselves, probably can't understand.)

683:t_042:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「But if the universe vanishes, everything ends.」

683:t_042:31.en:
$$刹那$$
「Now, the life of this universe is trying to unite in order to survive!」

683:t_042:32.en:
$n
「If we bring that power together, we won't lose, even to the force that seeks to vanish!」
